author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Hello, fellow forum user!
So, the title says it all. Basically, I'm suggesting we remove axes dropping on death on the map Gladiator. It's quite annoying how hard it is to pick stuff up on the map because of ten thousand axes cluttering your inventory, and in reality, you only need one. 
I know it's not a big deal or anything, but this could make the map a lot more enjoyable, and can make it easier to pick up other's armor upon their death.
Thoughts? :3
